{{Quote|Don't sound the general alarm. By all means look, but look quietly. Lord Vader has decided to pay us an unannounced visit. I don't want him to know about this until the intruders are caught."<br>"Yes, sir.|Malorum and his assistant|<ref name="Underworld" />}}
An [[Aide/Legends|assistant]] once served [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Head Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]]. Once they were made aware of intruders in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], the intruders being [[Ferus Olin]] and [[Trever Flume]], Malorum ordered the assistant to search for them quietly as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was due to arrive and he didn't want him to know there were intruders until they were captured. However, Vader quickly figured out there were intruders when he saw Imperials searching for them in the temple.<ref name="Underworld" />

==Behind the scenes==
The assistant first appeared in ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]''.<ref name="Underworld" /> Later in the [[Star Wars: The Last of the Jedi|Last of the Jedi]] books the character of [[Hydra (Grand Inquisitor)|Hydra]] was introduced, described as the former assistant of Malorum who has since replaced him as Head Inquisitor.<ref name="Secret Weapon">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]''</ref> It is unclear as to whether the two characters are intended to be the same.
